name: GTM v2 chapter 5: quote exceptions desk

parameters.formTitle: GTM pipeline v2: quote exceptions desk
parameters.formDescription: Reads every quote in Needs Review from Salesforce. Code checks the deal desk rules, the AI triages each quote, and you approve or reject every one, with a reason, on the next page. Nothing in Salesforce changes before you do, and nothing is sent to a customer.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: SELECT Id, GTM_Case_Id__c, Name, QuoteNumber, Status, ExpirationDate, BillingCountry, TotalPrice, GTM_Payment_Terms_Days__c, GTM_Term_Months__c, GTM_Special_Terms__c, GTM_Rep_Note__c, Account.Name, Opportunity.Name, Opportunity.Amount, Opportunity.CloseDate, (SELECT LineNumber, Product2.Name, Product2.ProductCode, Quantity, ListPrice, UnitPrice, Discount, TotalPrice FROM QuoteLineItems ORDER BY LineNumber) FROM Quote WHERE Status = 'Needs Review' ORDER BY GTM_Case_Id__c LIMIT 50

parameters.completionMessage: There are no quotes in Needs Review. Nothing was changed.

options.formTitle: Decide the quotes in the queue
options.formDescription: Quotes marked Check were flagged by the guard rails. Approve or reject every quote, with a reason. Rejected quotes go back to their owner.

parameters.query: select run_id, quotes, flagged, approved, rejected, written, failed, owners_told, against_proposal, calls, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_cost_usd, cost_per_quote_usd, avg_latency_ms from gtm_v2.desk_run_summary where run_id = $1;
